name: srp-blog-upv
description: Self-contained Unique Visitor / Page View counting service for srp-blog. Cloudflare Workers + D1, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.db:migrate:create: wrangler d1 migrations create srp-blog-stats -c wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply srp-blog-stats -c wrangler.toml --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply srp-blog-stats -c wrangler.toml --remote
scripts.db:migrate:list: wrangler d1 migrations list srp-blog-stats -c wrangler.toml --remote
